name: DataGrillen 2027
description: free community conference on the Microsoft data platform, with barbecue
note: on-site, English and German; 52 sessions in 4 tracks; venue of past editions: IT-Zentrum Lingen
details:
DataGrillen is a two-day community conference on the Microsoft data platform (SQL Server, Azure data, Fabric, Power BI, data engineering), known as the biggest free data platform event in northern Germany, with a barbecue evening.

The official site lists 13-14 May 2027, 52 sessions in 4 tracks and about 200 attendees. The 2027 venue is not named yet; past editions were at the IT-Zentrum Lingen, Kaiserstraße 10B.
